proposition.statement_en: A report presents the surah as newly revealed during a brief doze and explains al-Kawthar as a river granted in Paradise, associated with abundant good and a pool visited by the community.
proposition.supporting_span: قَالَ الْإِمَامُ أَحْمَدُ: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنِ الْمُخْتَارِ بْنِ فُلْفُل، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ قَالَ: أَغْفَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِغْفَاءَةً، فَرَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مُبْتَسِمًا، إِمَّا قَالَ لَهُمْ وَإِمَّا قَالُوا لَهُ: لِمَ ضَحِكْتَ؟ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: "إِنَّهُ أُنْزِلَتْ عليَّ آنِفًا سُورَةٌ". فَقَرَأَ: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ ﴿إِنَّا أَعْطَيْنَاكَ الْكَوْثَرَ﴾ حَتَّى خَتَمَهَا، قَالَ: "هَلْ تَدْرُونَ مَا الْكَوْثَرُ؟ "، قَالُوا: اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ. قَالَ: "هُوَ نَهْرٌ أَعْطَانِيهِ رَبِّي، عَزَّ وَجَلَّ، فِي الْجَنَّةِ، عَلَيْهِ خَيْرٌ كَثِيرٌ، تردُ عَلَيْهِ أُمَّتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، آنِيَتُهُ عَدَدَ الْكَوَاكِبِ، يُخْتَلَج الْعَبْدُ مِنْهُمْ فَأَقُولُ: يَا رَبِّ، إِنَّهُ مِنْ أُمَّتِي. فَيُقَالُ: إِنَّكَ لَا تَدْرِي مَا أَحْدَثُوا بَعْدَكَ".

evidence_units.content_summary: Doze, newly revealed surah, river granted in Paradise, abundant good and community arrival; does not explicitly say هو حوض in this version.

source_locator.arabic: وَقَدْ رَوَى هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ مُسْلِمٌ وَأَبُو دَاوُدَ وَالنَّسَائِيُّ، مِنْ طَرِيقِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ فُضَيْلٍ، وَعَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِر، كِلَاهُمَا عَنِ الْمُخْتَارِ بْنِ فُلْفُل، عَنْ أَنَسٍ. وَلَفَظُ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: "بَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بَيْنَ أَظْهُرِنَا فِي الْمَسْجِدِ، إِذْ أَغْفَى إِغْفَاءَةً ثُمَّ رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مُبْتَسِمًا، قُلْنَا: مَا أَضْحَكَكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ: "أُنْزِلَتْ عَلِيَّ آنِفًا سُورَةٌ"، فَقَرَأَ: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ ﴿إِنَّا أَعْطَيْنَاكَ الْكَوْثَرَ فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَانْحَرْ إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ الأبْتَرُ﴾ ثُمَّ قَالَ: "أَتَدْرُونَ مَا الْكَوْثَرُ؟ " قُلْنَا: اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ. قَالَ: "فَإِنَّهُ نَهْرٌ وَعَدنيه رَبِّي، عَزَّ وَجَلَّ، عَلَيْهِ خَيْرٌ كَثِيرٌ، هُوَ حَوْضٌ تَرِدُ عليه أمتي يوم القيامة، آنيته عدد النُّجُومِ  فَيختلجُ الْعَبْدُ مِنْهُمْ، فَأَقُولُ: رَبِّ إِنَّهُ مِنْ أُمَّتِي. فَيَقُولُ: إِنَّكَ لَا تَدْرِي مَا أَحْدَثَ بَعْدَكَ".

decisions.generated_ids: Omitted. Symbolic staging keys and *_ref are not database fields; resolve only in authorized reviewed workflows.
decisions.provenance_fields: Null; no normative or generality coding is asserted. Do not bypass provenance triggers.
decisions.compound_scope: Preserve existing claim wording; each evidence link specifies partial support. Supporting_span is the exact first report, not an invented concatenation.
decisions.remaining_routes: R02-R11 excluded from this draft; remain staged research with scope/edition/name/segmentation gaps. Their exclusion does not erase or resolve those gaps.

fidelity.english_entry_starts_before_span: Heading and basmala precede the revelation statement.
fidelity.bounded_absence: No English narration of dozing appears before the opening revelation statement; do not label the doze clause bilingually aligned.
fidelity.scope: This is a finding about the stored abridged witness, not every English edition.
fidelity.english_intermediate_links: The English retains Ahmad/Muhammad bin Fudayl/al-Mukhtar/Anas attribution but does not preserve all Arabic collection-wrapper detail.

clause_support.brief_doze: Explicit in both Arabic report versions; omitted before revelation statement in the stored English opening.
clause_support.newly_revealed_surah: Explicit in Arabic Ahmad and Muslim versions and English opening.
clause_support.river_in_paradise: Explicit in Ahmad Arabic; Muslim version here says promised river, without repeating Paradise in that sentence. Do not silently create one composite quotation.
clause_support.abundant_good: Explicit in both Arabic versions and English.
clause_support.pool_visited_by_community: Muslim Arabic explicitly says هو حوض; Ahmad Arabic says the community comes to it. Preserve exact wording.
clause_support.commentator_bridge: Ibn Kathir's intervening explanation of two channels feeding the pool from al-Kawthar is distinct commentator voice, not part of Anas's quoted chain.
